summary: Verified the regenerated /app/backend/deploy/deploy_email.sh. 9/9 script-focused tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_deploy_email_script.py: (1) all 4 embedded base64 heredocs byte-decode to files identical to /app/backend/emailer.py, /app/backend/models.py, /app/backend/seed.py, /app/backend/routes/auth_routes.py; (2) decoded auth_routes.py contains _generate_strong_password + build_google_welcome_email and no longer contains the old 'if user and user.password_hash:' gate; (3) decoded emailer.py has BG="#e3f4e9" (no white BG) and build_google_welcome_email present; (4) bash -n syntax check passes; (5) full deploy simulation against /tmp/vps-sim-ok with stubbed systemctl/chown/pkill/journalctl/curl exit 0 succeeds (rc=0): corrupt '"#====..."' line is removed from .env, no line starts with a quote, FRONTEND_BASE_URL is preserved as https://binaryfundglobal.com (NOT clobbered by add_env_keep default), all 7 SMTP_* keys present exactly once, all 4 files written identical to /app/backend sources, and stdout contains 'HEALTH OK'; (6) failing-health-check branch (curl stub exits 1) still returns rc=0 but stdout contains '!! HEALTH CHECK FAILED' and does NOT contain 'HEALTH OK' — retry loop works. The 2 local-backend regression tests are SKIPPED because this container has no Postgres installed (no /etc/postgresql, no postgres user, no pg_lsclusters binary) so uvicorn crashes at startup with 'Connect call failed 127.0.0.1:5432'; the auth code itself was already validated 12/12 in iteration_13 and the script byte-embeds those same source files.

.env sanitation covers the reported corruption: strips CR, drops lines starting with double quote, drops lines starting with single quote, drops '#===' divider lines. The exact corrupt input '"#====..."' is removed in the simulation.
Health-retry loop (15 x 3s = up to 45s) replaces the old fixed 6s sleep; on curl failure the script emits 'HEALTH CHECK FAILED' rather than a false success — verified in the failing-branch test.
Script exits 0 even on health-check failure. Consider `exit 1` in the failure branch so systemd/CI can detect a bad deploy — low priority since the message is prominent in operator output.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_deploy_email_script.py — pure local (no VPS, no network). Extracts base64 heredocs with a regex, byte-compares against /app/backend sources, and runs the whole script twice under PATH=stub-dir with APP_DIR override. If /app/backend files are updated, the tests will fail until the base64 heredocs in deploy_email.sh are also regenerated — this is the intended guardrail. Postgres is NOT installed locally in this container; the 2 regression tests self-skip via `_backend_up()`.
rca of the issue: USER RCA: (a) deploy_email.sh had stale base64 payloads (old auth_routes.py with the Google-only-blocks-reset gate, old emailer.py without build_google_welcome_email and with white BG). Fix: regenerated all 4 heredocs from current /app/backend sources — verified byte-identical. (b) VPS .env line 1 was a corrupt quoted divider `"#====..."` causing systemd + python-dotenv parse warnings. Fix: sed sanitation strips CR + drops lines starting with a single or double quote + drops #=== dividers — verified the exact reported line is removed. (c) 6s post-restart sleep was shorter than ~9s app startup so curl fired before uvicorn was ready and reported a false 502. Fix: 15-iteration retry loop (3s each = up to 45s) with a HEALTH_OK flag — verified retry runs and both success and failure branches emit correct output.
